description: Renames the IO system of a controller interface and/or changes its number (neither passed: 400 missing_param). `controllerInterface` is the interface item name from tia_device_network (default: the primary network interface). A number outside 100-115 is 400 invalid_io_system_number and one another IO system already has is 409 io_system_number_in_use (details.usedBy), or 409 subnet_inventory_incomplete (details.gaps) when the IO systems of a subnet could not be listed to check it. Also refused, nothing changed: 409 no_io_system (the controller has no IO system: create it with tia_io_system_create), 409 not_io_controller, 404 not_found. Only the values that differ are written; the result carries `ioSystem`, `changes` and a `postcheck` (the serve re-reads the IO system after the write); a mismatch is 409 postcheck_failed (details.mismatches; details.rollback says whether the previous name and number were restored, verified by a fresh read; details.restoreFailures lists every field NOT back at its previous value): re-read with tia_io_systems. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (needs an open project): it runs the same guards and returns the plan WITHOUT changing anything. Maps to POST /iosystems/update. M-off.

controllerInterface.description: controller interface item name, as listed by tia_device_network (default: the primary network interface)

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project
